verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Atlassian documents an official MCP server in its own GitHub organization (atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server). That is a first-party way to connect an agent to Jira. The evidence is only a single probe line, with no detail on supported Jira tools, authentication, setup, or hosting. Missing for 10: documented Jira tool coverage and operations, auth/setup instructions for connecting agents, any independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
